# BROSKI Pet Food

> Fresh, crunchy dog biscuits packed by hand in Nangloi, West Delhi 110041. Wholesome daily treats at honest pricing (₹149 & ₹179 per 400g zip pouch) for Indian dog parents.

## Overview
BROSKI is an independent dog treat brand founded by Lakshay in West Delhi, India. We make crunchy bone-shaped biscuits formulated for daily rewarding, training, and treat time. All batches are packed fresh in sealed, food-grade stand-up pouches with zip closures to preserve aroma and crunch without harsh chemical preservatives.

- **Founder & Owner:** Lakshay (Sole Proprietorship)
- **Headquarters:** 12A/3, Dharam Colony, Nangloi, New Delhi 110041, India
- **MSME / Udyam Registration:** UDYAM-DL-11-0177908
- **Primary Sales Channels:** Direct on WhatsApp, website, and local pet specialty stores across West Delhi.
- **Website:** https://broskipetfood.com/

## Core Products

- [BROSKI Non-Veg Dog Biscuits (400g)](https://broskipetfood.com/): Crunchy bone-shaped dog biscuits baked with real bone broth and liver extract. Formulated for everyday dogs. Packaged in a yellow stand-up zip pouch (400g net weight). MRP: ₹149.
- [BROSKI Mix Flavour Dog Biscuits (400g)](https://broskipetfood.com/): Multi-flavour blend combining milk solids, vegetable extracts, and savory broth for fussy eaters. Packaged in a yellow stand-up zip pouch (400g net weight). MRP: ₹179.
- [BROSKI Peanut Butter Dog Biscuits (400g)](https://broskipetfood.com/): Vegetarian-friendly crunchy treats made with roasted peanut butter. Packaged in a yellow stand-up zip pouch (400g net weight). MRP: ₹179.
- [Taste Test Sampler Pouch (50g)](https://broskipetfood.com/r/): 50g mini pouches with QR code distributed across Delhi clinics, grooming salons, and parks for dog parents to test their dog's taste preference before buying a full 400g pouch.

## Ordering & Contact

- **WhatsApp Direct Ordering:** Tap the "Order on WhatsApp" button on https://broskipetfood.com/ to order directly with instant delivery confirmation.
- **Email Inquiries:** hello@broskipetfood.com or support@broskipetfood.com
- **Customer Support Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 09:00 to 20:00 IST.
- **Accepted Payments:** UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery (Delhi NCR).

## Guarantees & Brand Commitments
1. **Honest Treats:** No misleading health, medical, calming, or "vet approved" claims.
2. **Fresh Packaging:** Every pouch is sealed with a reusable zip-lock to maintain oven-fresh crunch.
3. **Delhi Direct:** Locally packed in Nangloi, West Delhi, keeping overhead low so pet parents get high quality at half the price of imported treats.
